description: This file defines the AxisTitleRenderer class responsible for rendering axis titles (x and y axes) in a chart, including calculating space and drawing the title with optional rotation.

classes.name: AxisTitleRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing axis titles in charts, handling size calculation and rendering with rotation and alignment.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space needed for the axis title, considering rotation.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the axis title on the graphics context, applying rotation and alignment.
